newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Australia's Hazelwood project financing signed.
newsitem.headline: Australia's Hazelwood project financing signed.

text.p: The A$1,325 million credit facilities for Hazelwood Power Project were signed in Melbourne, the lead arranger and underwriters said.
The financing has a maturity of 12 years.
UBS Australia is the lead arranger and underwriter.
Other underwriters are Citibank, Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Societe Generale Australia.
Lead managers are Bank of Tokyo-Mitsubishi (Australia), Deutsche Bank and WestLB Sydney branch.
Senior managers are ANZ Banking Group, Credit Lyonnais Australia and Royal Bank of Scotland.

Managers are ABN AMRO Australia, Banque Nationale de Paris, Dresdner Australia, Fuji International Finance (Australia), Indosuez Australia, LTCB Australia, Sakura Finance Australia, Sanwa Australia, Bank of America and Sumitomo International Finance Australia.
